why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: Re-derived from the 26.1.2 sources and javap, not inherited. The authors removed three handlers; each has a 26.1.2 home with 1.21.1's effect. renderClouds HEAD: clouds are a frame-graph pass whose lambda (lambda$addCloudsPass$0) first tries LevelRenderState.customCloudsRenderer (null-checked) and only then CloudRenderer.render, so the skip is a HEAD cancel of that lambda (require = 1) -- it also covers dimensions drawing their own clouds, which the CloudRendererMixin gate (kept as a second gate) alone missed. renderEntity: the @Redirect of EntityRenderDispatcher.submit in submitEntities sets the cloud-occlusion flag in the main pass, before the clouds pass runs. renderSky TAIL: AfterSky only fires inside the sky pass, which renderLevel omits when shouldRenderSky (!bossOverlay.shouldCreateWorldFog()) is false and addSkyPass omits for Skybox NONE, lava/powder snow and sky-blocking effects, and it fires even after a custom CustomSkyboxRenderer.renderSky returned true; so the skybox is drawn from its own pass on targets.main injected before addMainPass (require = 1), with RenderSystem.setShaderFog(terrainFog) as the sky pass does, skipped when the @ModifyExpressionValue on renderSky in lambda$addSkyPass$0 (require = 1) saw it return true and, on a frame with no sky pass (shouldRenderSky false for boss world fog, Skybox NONE, lava/powder snow, sky-blocking effects, where 26.1.2 never calls renderSky but 1.21.1 still asked it before the TAIL), when levelRenderState.customSkyboxRenderer is non-null (extractLevel fills it before renderLevel, per javap of minecraft-patched-26.1.2.116-merged.jar), and GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned makes the AfterSky handler stand down. renderLevel multiplies modelViewMatrix onto RenderSystem's model-view stack and LegacyGl/RenderType.draw upload getModelViewMatrix() as ModelViewMat, so the skybox PoseStack starts from identity (the old new Matrix4f(event.getModelViewMatrix()) applied the view rotation twice).
